Solution written to **`~/boardctl-partial-delivery-solution.md`**.

## Summary

**Root cause:** `boardctl`'s `--status` is a closed write vocabulary `{in_progress, review, blocked, complete, failed, pending}`. `partial` is not a member, so `boardctl update --status partial` is rejected (rc=1) before any write, and `board-write.sh` surfaces that as rc=2 and leaves the row untouched. `complete` is separately gated by `--evidence-run-id` (TR-251), so faking completion is also blocked.

**Fix:** Encode partial delivery as `--status blocked` (the truthful state) plus metadata:
```sh
scripts/board-write.sh update <ID> \
  --status blocked \
  --blocked-reason "AC2 unmet: blocked on <dependency row>" \
  --worker-status complete \
  --commit-hash <sha-of-landed-work> \
  --guard PASS --ci SKIP \
  --summary "AC1 met & verified how; AC2 blocked on <dep>" \
  --note "tick=<tick> verdict=<verdict>"
```

**Key gotchas verified empirically on `boardctl v0.4.0` (fresh board in `/tmp`):**
- `--note` is stored under `foreman_note`, never `note` (and it appends, blank-line separated). Read back `.foreman_note`.
- `board-write.sh` does `git add .coding-hermes/board/` — an unrelated uncommitted board edit (I reproduced with a second `boardctl create`) rides into the same commit. Check/stash `git status --short .coding-hermes/board/` first.
- The refusal genuinely leaves the row unchanged (status stayed `pending`), but it also leaves your task unrecorded, which is why the recipe is required.
- `--status complete` without `--evidence-run-id` returns rc=1 (TR-251), confirming you cannot fake it.

The markdown contains the full command template, a filled example, an optional reusable helper, the field-by-field rationale, and a verification section with observed rc and read-back values.

RECIPE for work where some acceptance criteria landed and others are blocked by an external dependency: --status blocked with --blocked-reason naming the unmet ACs and the dependency row, --worker-status complete, --commit-hash <sha of the landed work>, --guard PASS --ci SKIP, --summary spelling out which ACs are met and how they were verified, plus --note for the tick id and verdict id. Never fake a 'complete'. ALSO: boardctl writes a note into the row key `foreman_note` (not `note`), so read back .foreman_note; and board-write.sh stages the WHOLE .coding-hermes/board/ dir, so any other uncommitted board edit you made just before it will ride along in the same verified commit. VERIFIED 2026-11-15 on heading HD-CI-001.
